title: Boiled eggs
summary: Soft, jammy or hard: pick your yolk.
source: Written for REMY by Claude, timers from cook-times.json (eggs). Waiting for Matthew's review.
notes: REMY: before starting the timer, ASK how they like the yolk (soft and runny, jammy, or hard) and use step 2's timer_by_shape. Times are for fridge-cold large eggs lowered into already boiling water. Runny yolks are a personal choice. For anyone vulnerable (pregnant, elderly, very young, unwell), cook until yolk and white are firm: see food-safety.json.

steps.instruction: Bring a saucepan of water to a full boil. Have a bowl of cold water ready.
looks_wrong: only small bubbles at the bottom (not boiling yet)
steps.done_when: The water is at a rolling boil.

steps.instruction: Gently lower the eggs into the boiling water with a spoon, then turn the heat down so it bubbles steadily.
looks_right: eggs resting on the bottom, steady bubbles
looks_wrong: water boiling so hard the eggs bash around
steps.done_when: The timer for the yolk they chose has finished.

steps.instruction: Lift the eggs straight into the cold water for a minute so they stop cooking, then peel or crack the top off.
looks_wrong: eggs left in the hot pan (they keep cooking)
steps.done_when: Cool enough to hold and ready to eat.
